jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior .NET Architect to lead the architecture, modernization, and technical governance of a portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys shaping architecture strategy, mentoring development teams, and driving large-scale modernization initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.
Key responsibilities

• Lead the architecture of multiple application domains and enterprise solutions

• Define target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps

• Guide development teams on architecture decisions and complex technical challenges

• Lead migrations from legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET platforms

• Drive cloud-native and containerization initiatives

• Architect scalable MicroServices and distributed systems solutions

• Provide architectural guidance for Blazor applications

• Mentor and coach Full Stack .NET development teams

• Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical governance activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders

Nice to have

• Kubernetes (K8s)

• Cloud-Native Architecture

• Containerization Strategies

• Dapr

• NServiceBus

• Hangfire

• Distributed Systems Architecture

• Experience within Energy, Utilities, or Infrastructure sectors

What we're looking for

You are a strategic yet hands-on architect with a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and modern software solutions. You can influence technical direction, mentor engineering teams, and successfully drive modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

📩 Interested? Feel free to reach out or share your updated CV for a confidential discussion.

• Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect

• Strong expertise in:

• 

• C#

• .NET (Modern .NET & Legacy .NET Framework)

• Blazor

• SQL Server

• MongoDB

• RabbitMQ

• strong knowledge of

• Clean Architecture

• Software Architecture Design

• Technical Leadership

• experience with

• MicroServices Architecture

• Enterprise Application Modernization

• Leading Development Teams

• Technical Governance

• Cross-Team Technical Delivery

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional English skills

• Dutch or French language proficiency

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

 

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools

• Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications across the full technology stack.

• Develop and integrate REST APIs.

• Strong understanding of SQL, REST APIs, GIT, and software development best practices.

• Proven experience maintaining and modernizing legacy applications in production environments.

• Ability to identify and remediate security issues in existing codebases.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Current stack: PHP 5.6/7.4, CodeIgniter, Smarty, AngularJS, JQuery

• Target stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12+, Vue 3, JavaScript

• Experience with Laravel and/or Vue.js.

• Background in application modernization and legacy migration projects.

• Knowledge of application security best practices.

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical & Piping Project Engineer - Technical Lead
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This position centres on senior technical project engineering rather than administrative coordination or traditional project management. As Technical Lead on multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, you help develop and deliver solutions that are safe, feasible and maintainable within a controlled project setting.

You will work in an operational brownfield environment where safety, reliability, technical quality and minimal disruption to production are key considerations. The role combines specialist Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad understanding of engineering, execution and handover activities.

Responsibilities

• Define and maintain the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
• Coordinate engineering activities across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core area and close collaboration with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure teams.
• Plan and lead design reviews, assessing solutions against safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
• Translate process and project requirements into Mechanical & Piping concepts and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
• Assess technical alternatives in terms of feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
• Provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, while critically reviewing their content, quality, planning and completeness of deliverables.
• Support technical decisions, document assumptions and deviations, and keep decisions and follow-up actions traceable.
• Identify technical and project risks and evaluate the impact of changes on scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
• Contribute to technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and technical clarifications related to contracts.
• Follow up relevant Mechanical & Piping activities, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through mechanical completion.
• Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
• Assist the Project Manager with clear technical recommendations and transparent reporting to stakeholders.
• Coach engineers and help develop project engineering standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The selection process includes two interview rounds: an initial interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview with a business case.

• You hold a master's degree in a technical discipline, or have reached an equivalent level through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
• You have extensive experience in technical design and engineering in an industrial or process environment.
• You bring demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering within the process industry or another heavy industrial environment.
• You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
• You are able to provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors and critically evaluate their deliverables.
• You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, including PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
• You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain one before starting.
• Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an advantage.
• You can work with project controls covering scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
• You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• You explain complex technical topics clearly and collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.
• You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented way and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
  
 
  
You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
  
Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

  
• Degree: You have a Master's degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.  
• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment.  
• Skills:  
•      
• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.   
• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail.   
• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact.   
• You work independently and in a disciplined manner.   
• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken).    
• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

Your role: payroll expertise with room to grow 

Own the payroll essentials
  
• Coordinate Belgian payroll administration for approximately 30 employees, working with external payroll partners and ensuring timely, accurate input and follow-up. 
• Manage employee records, contracts, absences, benefits and personnel changes. 
• Act as a first point of contact for payroll and day-to-day HR questions. 
• Help maintain accurate HR reporting and compliance with Belgian employment requirements.  
Become involved in broader HR
  
• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, ensuring new colleagues feel welcome and supported. 
• Contribute to employee benefits, mobility and cafeteria plan initiatives. 
• Help improve HR processes, procedures and employee-facing information. 
• Support recruitment coordination, training, engagement and other HR projects.  
You'll be trusted to take ownership of your work, while collaborating closely with experienced HR colleagues. The aim is to give you meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to keep learning—not to expect you to know every aspect of HR already.

Is this your next step? 
 
• Around three years or more of relevant experience in Belgian payroll and HR administration, including benefits. 
• Enough practical payroll knowledge to take ownership of day-to-day coordination quickly; SD Worx experience is a strong advantage. 
• Good knowledge of Belgian employment administration, confidence with Excel and an interest in HR systems. 
• Excellent English, Dutch at minimum B2 level with a B1 in French. French-speaking candidates with B2 Dutch and excellent English are equally welcome. 
• An organised, accurate, proactive and service-minded approach; you enjoy helping people and taking initiative. 
• A genuine interest in broadening your HR experience and building a lasting role in a collaborative team.  
A background in a law firm or consultancy, or a specific HR degree, is welcome but not required.

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.

jobs.occupation: Assistant (all genders) in our EU Representation in Brussels
jobs.description:
• Provide organisational and administrative support to the Brussels team, working closely with the Executive Management Assistant  
• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges  
• Manage shared mailboxes and coordinate appointments, deadlines and outstanding tasks  
• Assist with preparing and updating documents, presentations and position papers, including final quality checks  
• Coordinate the monthly eu-flash newsletter and help maintain the website and other information materials  
• Coordinate with internal and external service providers (e.g. IT and suppliers), check invoices and prepare cost summaries  
• Assist with onboarding new employees and interns 
  
• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

JOB FOCUS 
 
  The incumbent is responsible for the processes on archiving completeness and transport document compliance for documents related to Global Logistics shipments. The incumbent drives process automation and process outsourcing to ensure timely and correct execution of compliance and completeness checks of transport documents. 
 
  The incumbent orchestrates and coordinates activities with relevant internal and external stakeholders to recover missing documentation and/or correct any issues identified.
